headline: Adopted policy limiting civil law enforcement on school grounds; sent metal detector and school safety options to a subcommittee.
summary: Speakers during public comment urged fair pay, fair contracts, and 90 days of assault leave for paraprofessionals. Officials also reported enrollment down approximately 126 students, with a potential impact of approximately $3 million, and reviewed the August 27 swatting incident and lockdown at Holyoke High School North.
decisions: Referred cell phone accessibility and connectivity to the Parent and Engagement Committee, unanimously.
Adopted policy on civil law enforcement activities on school grounds on second and final reading, unanimously.
Approved out-of-state travel for M. Semidei to attend La Cosecha Conference 2026 in Santa Fe, NM, unanimously.
Accepted FY27 grants and gifts detail, unanimously.
Referred order on school safety and security, including permanent metal detectors, to the Finance and Operations Subcommittee, 9-1.
Approved minutes of the 6.22.26 School Committee meeting, unanimously.
Approved minutes of the 7.13.26 School Committee meeting, unanimously.
Approved minutes of the 6.3.26 Parent and Community Engagement meeting, unanimously.
Approved purpose statement for the Parent and Caregiver Engagement Ad Hoc Committee, 9-1.
Approved a one-year timeline with a six-month check-in for the Ad Hoc committee, and parent leader reports to the full committee, unanimously.
Tabled the definition of meaningful parent and caregiver engagement, unanimously.
Approved policy CA-Administration Goals on first reading, then second and final reading, unanimously.
Failed on a roll call vote: first reading of recommended changes to policy BEDB-Amended 8.26.26.
Removed policies IA-Instructional Goals and IE-Organization of Instructions from first reading, unanimously.
Approved policy GBD-School Community-Staff Communications on second and final reading, with wording changes, unanimously.
Approved nine policies as a package on second and final reading, unanimously.
